title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-29
source: Set 2, Handheld Sony 1 point stereo mic from the 5th and 4th row sometimes standing on chair; Recorderd and transferred by Chaffe McIlhenny; Master cassette>Revox cassette deck to DAT in 1998> to Tascam P2 Flash Card in Oct 2014>Audacity>Traders Little Helper for FLAC Fingerprint creation

ai_review.summary: Atmospheric audience recording delivers a high‑energy second set with a smoking Truckin' > The Other One > Rat sequence, captured in surprisingly clear sound despite rhythm‑guitar dominance.
ai_review.review: Pig's Pal praises the tape’s vivid, “you‑are‑there” atmosphere and notes the unusually clean jams with minimal crowd bleed. The second‑set highlights – especially the insane Truckin’ into The Other One and Rat segment – are described as wonderful Dead Jazz interplay, though the proximity to the stage makes Bob Weir’s rhythm guitar dominate the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: The single detailed review is highly positive about both performance and audio, suggesting a strong show (≈70% weight) and good‑to‑excellent recording quality (≈30% weight), yielding an overall rating around 4.3.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Atmospheric feel with minimal crowd noise; clear jam sections but rhythm guitar is overly forward due to mic placement near Bob Weir.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set flows strongly with tight transitions, especially the intense Truckin'‑> Other One‑> Rat sequence; reviewer notes missing first set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Enough Jerry in the mix for a clean, trippy jam feel.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar dominates due to mic proximity, giving Bob a pronounced presence.
